segments.text: Thus being rightly gathered, eſtabliſhed, and ſtill proceeding in Chriſtian communion, and obedience of the Goſpel of Chriſt, none ought to ſeparate for faults and corruptions, which may, and as long as the Church conſiſts of men ſubject to failings, will fall out and ariſe amongſt them, even in true conſtituted Churches, untill they have in due order ſought redreſſe thereof.
